description: H2 excited states, TDA, the lowest root at one rung (protocol 1e-4, k 6) plus static alpha_zz. excited.num_states is 1 so the case fits the medium tier; the same deck at 2 roots gave the identical omega_0 to 1e-13. The response block sets dconv 1e-4 explicitly: left unset it derives to 100*thresh = 0.01, and since the FD/ES gates ride at 5*dconv that 5e-2 gate let the ES solve stop after 2 iterations. At dconv 1e-4 the gates are 5e-4: 7 envelope iterations, the FD leg at bsh 2.3e-6 and the ES root at bsh 1.2e-5 / density 6.4e-6 after 5 ES iterations. Reference: RelWithDebInfo, TBB, 1 rank x 7 threads, Seawulf Milan long-96core-shared, 2026-09-21, commit 80e89f829 (job 2193425), wall 21 s. omega tol 1e-3 au.
